description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Wrike tasks in a target Folder. Rows are matched to existing tasks by a key marker embedded in the task description (e.g. <!-- dagster-key: INC-1001 -->); Wrike has no native upsert endpoint for tasks.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Wrike task (upserted via key_column).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Wrike.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

folder_id.label: Folder Id
folder_id.description: Target Wrike Folder ID tasks are created/matched in.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream column holding a stable unique key, embedded as a dagster-key marker in the task description.

status_column.label: Status Column
status_column.description: Column holding a Wrike status: Active, Completed, Deferred, or Cancelled.

importance_column.label: Importance Column
importance_column.description: Column holding a Wrike importance: High, Normal, or Low.

due_date_column.label: Due Date Column
due_date_column.description: Column holding an ISO-8601 due date, sent as dates.due.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows to process per run (safety cap).

name: Wrike Task Upsert
